entries.name: Strike
entries.description: A measured blow.

entries.name: Off-hand Jab
entries.description: Melee jab with the off-hand weapon (or bare hands) at distance 1: ranged units' point-blank answer.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries.description: Shield Bash: 80% power, 70% to Stagger for 1 round.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries.description: Hamstring: 80% power, 80% to Root for 1 round.

entries.name: Shockwave
entries.description: Hits the 3 tiles in a line from you (aim at an adjacent tile). Friendly fire!

entries.name: Volley
entries.description: Volley: 70% power. Plus area, hits allies too. Needs bow/crossbow training 1.

entries.name: Firebomb
entries.description: Firebomb: 60% power. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs staff/wand training 1. Hits a 3x3 area around a tile 2 away.

entries.name: Guard
entries.description: Raise a light guard: -30% damage.

entries.name: Focus
entries.description: Focus: +50% attack for 2 rounds.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: Move up to 2 blocks (speed-based tiles per block), once per round: 1 AP per tile. Keeps your stance.

entries.name: Switch Target
entries.description: Lock onto a different enemy (no AP). Added automatically when an attack changes target.

entries.name: Staggered
entries.description: Block lost to Stagger.

entries.name: Stunned
entries.description: Block lost to Stun.

entries.name: Rest
entries.description: Catch your breath: recover 2 AP and return to Neutral stance, free.

entries.name: Sunder
entries.description: Sunder: 120% power, 50% to Stagger for 1 round. Needs axe/mace/hammer training 2. Armor-breaking chop.

entries.name: Reckless Swing
entries.description: All-in swing: 170% power. Needs axe/sword/hammer training 2.

entries.name: Aimed Shot
entries.description: Aimed Shot: 140% power. Needs bow/crossbow training 2. A patient shot.

entries.name: Pinning Shot

entries.name: Arcane Bolt

entries.name: Quick Stab

entries.name: Mend
entries.description: Mend: heals 8 + 1.5 x KNOW. A friendly unit within 3 tiles, or yourself.

entries.name: Rally
entries.description: Rally: grants haste for 1 round starting next round. +1 tile per move block.

entries.name: Taunt Shout
entries.description: Taunt Shout: grants taunt for 2 rounds starting next round. Foes that can reach you must target you.

entries.name: Lunge

entries.name: Riposte
entries.description: Riposte: -15% damage; grants riposte for 2 rounds. Adjacent melee attackers you survive are countered for 50% of your attack power (once per attacker per round). Any stance change ends it; moving does not.

entries.name: Purify
entries.description: Purify: cleanses stun. Active or pending debuffs on a friendly unit within 3 tiles, or yourself. Buffs stay.
